purpose: y2s60: Nord2Metal only (y2s59 + three changes). (1) young reconvert: in MobileSlideShow a two-plane YCbCr texture converted on the GPU (format 500, planes in place) is converted again at every use for its first 3 s ('SURF young reconvert n=...'; off with /var/db/nord2-metal/no-young-reconvert): run ph5's grid cell pictures (375x667 '420f') were converted once when their textures were made and the grid went dark that frame. (2) touch: a surface-backed texture a compute dispatch writes IN PLACE has its IOSurface locked/unlocked for writing after the command buffer completes, so its seed moves and every copy/conversion of it is redone ('SURF touch n=...'; off with /var/db/nord2-metal/no-gpu-touch). (3) the PHOTOS probe also prints the textures each grid frame sampled with their centre texel ('PHOTOS frame n=... sampled: ...'). Backup Nord2Metal.pre-vt20; undo: guest-vt20-undo.sh (back to y2s59-vt19).
